typography.mono: JetBrains Mono, Medium 11px uppercase with high tracking

design.layout: Full-bleed immersive background with a centered vertical stack for content. The navigation is housed in a floating pill-shaped container at the top center, mirroring the rounded decorative elements throughout.
design.motion: Slow parallax on cloud layers to create depth. Text elements should use a gentle 'blur and fade-in' reveal as the page loads. Subtle twinkling animations on the star field.
guardrails: Avoid using pure #000000; keep blacks deep but nuanced.
Do not use standard sans-serifs for the headline; it requires high-contrast serifs.
Prevent CTA buttons from having solid fills; keep them ephemeral and glass-like.
Avoid grid-heavy layouts; let the clouds dictate the negative space.
design.centerpiece: Dramatic low-angle view of a stylized nocturnal sky filled with ink-wash cumulus clouds and starlight.
design.mood: Sophisticated, ethereal, and high-tech with a nod to classical romanticism and Japanese charcoal illustration.
